title: A session-time lore producer leaves cache generation directories without the owner write bit, so the owner cannot delete the checkout
description: FILED, NOT BUILT. Relayed by team-lead 2026-10-13; opum-doc ruled under DEC-183 (g) that this rides behind the v0.14.0 pair (constitution Article 3), so it is not in LCLI-714. FINDING: a session-time lore producer writes cache generation directories without the u+w bit inside whatever checkout a Claude session starts in, and the owner then cannot delete that checkout. MEASURED 2026-10-13 by opum-desktop in its DEC-183 reader worktree .claude/worktrees/review-36 (a relayed measurement, not re-resolved here): .lore/cache/graph/ladybug/1/generations/8ab4c4c5.../ has mode dr-xr-xr-x and holds projection.lbdb (r--r--r--) and index.json (r--------). It was created at 14:26 local by the reader session itself; nothing ran in the worktree before the spawn. git worktree remove then failed with Permission denied after partially deleting the tree; the same happened earlier with review-28 and review-31. opum-workflow 0.15.8 session-start.sh and session-end.sh do not invoke lore, so the opum-lore plugin session module (or a lore CLI call it makes) is the likely producer, UNVERIFIED. QUESTIONS THIS TASK ANSWERS: (1) which code path produces the generation directories at session time, and with what modes; (2) are the read-only bits deliberate (immutable generations)? PENDING DESIGN QUESTION, for opum-doc: do not pick a fix. Candidate (a): generations stay read-only and lore exposes a supported cleanup. Candidate (b): a reviewer session skips the cache. Related prior knowledge: ladybug directories are read-only in test fixtures and need chmod before rm (see the fixture scaffolding note).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The code path that creates a generation directory at session time is identified, with the modes it sets, and the finding is recorded on this task
The task records whether the read-only modes are deliberate, citing the code or ADR that says so
opum-doc's design ruling between the supported-cleanup arm and the reviewer-skips-cache arm is recorded before any code changes
Whichever arm is ruled, a checkout whose session created a generation can be removed by its owner with git worktree remove, shown by a reproduction before and after
